package.description: The Free and Fast Arena Shooter

en-US.description: The Free and Fast Arena Shooter
en-US.longDescription:
Xonotic is an addictive arena-style first person shooter with crisp movement and a wide array of
weapons. It combines intuitive mechanics with in-your-face action to elevate your heart rate.
Xonotic will always be free to play and modify under the copyleft GPLv3+ license.
